title: Q-BORROW-pr-agent: run PR-Agent as a reviewer in the merge lane
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --plugged pr-agent
**Status:** open

BORROW-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-26): plug in a competitor's best step instead of rebuilding it. Add a workflow `.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml` that runs the open-source PR-Agent action (https://github.com/The-PR-Agent/pr-agent) on pull requests, with model calls on GitHub Models through the built-in token (no stored key), the budget headers `scripts/lint_workflows.py` requires, a timeout, a concurrency group and the HALT guard. Its review is advisory: it never blocks a merge. Then set the `pr-agent` row in doctrine/competitors.json to `"status": "live"` with probe `file:.github/workflows/pr-agent.yml` in the same change.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --plugged pr-agent

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`)

**Out of scope:** paid reviewers, any stored API key, or making the review a required check.
